2025_098_may_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for May 2025 lists district PCARD activity line by line, giving the merchant, the journal-entry label MAY 2025 PCARD EXP, the full accounting code, the transaction date, the amount, and any credit. Dated activity runs from 4/28/25 through 5/26/25 across a 31-page printout footed 7/9/25. The listing closes with a grand total of 385,539.19. The single largest line is 9,540.00 to PY *RRCNA on 5/21/25, followed by 8,240.00 to PAY*YMCA CAMP COPNECON on 5/23/25.
